categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Changes .github/workflows/ci.yml and multiple ci/ scripts to replace FreeBSD cross-compilation with a native VM CI job.
categories.rationale: Catches FreeBSD platform regressions in per-PR CI before they reach master. The author and reviewers cite recent master regressions (e.g., #36078 and #36145) that required reactive fixes because tests were not executed on BSD targets, making this a durable reliability improvement for supported platform testing.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled Tests, but changes are CI configuration and scripts; the single edit in test/ (netutil.py +1/-1) merely follows from running under FreeBSD.
categories.rationale: CI workflow and runner configuration belong to Build and CI rather than test framework infrastructure. The minor one-line adjustment in netutil.py merely follows from adapting the runner environment.
